caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата представлява двупръстенна (donut/sunburst) секторна диаграма, която показва разпределение на персонажи по основни категории и подкатегории. Вътрешният пръстен съдържа 3 сектора: „Virtual Characters“ (син, приблизително 60% от кръга), „Custom Characters“ (розов, малък дял) и „Real Characters“ (зелен, малък до умерен дял). Външният пръстен съдържа общо 13 подкатегории: към „Virtual Characters“ има 5 светлосини сектора с етикети „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“ и „Game Characters“; към „Real Characters“ има 7 светлозелени сектора с етикети „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ и „Influencers“; секторът „Custom Characters“ (светлорозов) няма изписани подкатегории във външния пръстен. Диаграмата няма отделна легенда и не показва числови проценти върху секторите; секторите са оцветени по групи (сини за виртуални, зелени за реални, розови за персонализирани), без визуално „издърпани“ или допълнително подчертани сегменти.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a two-level donut (sunburst-style) pie chart showing the distribution of characters in “RoleplayPref,” with an inner ring of three primary categories and an outer ring of 13 subcategories. The inner ring has 3 slices: Virtual Characters (blue, roughly about 60% of the circle), Custom Characters (pink, roughly about 10–15%), and Real Characters (green, roughly about 25–30%). The outer ring subdivides Virtual Characters into 5 light-blue slices labeled Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Comic Characters appearing largest among the virtual subcategories and the others smaller and similar in size. Real Characters are subdivided into 7 light-green slices labeled Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians appearing largest among the real-character subcategories and the remaining slices smaller. Custom Characters has no labeled outer subcategories (the pink outer portion is a single unlabeled segment). Labels are placed directly on or near slices; there is no separate legend and no numeric percentage annotations inside the slices, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Die Abbildung ist ein zweistufiges (Donut-/Sunburst-)Kreisdiagramm, das die Verteilung von Charaktertypen in „RoleplayPref“ zeigt: ein innerer Ring mit drei Hauptkategorien und ein äußerer Ring mit insgesamt 13 Unterkategorien. Im inneren Ring sind „Virtual Characters“ als größtes Segment in Blau (etwa 60%), „Custom Characters“ als kleineres Segment in Rosa (ca. 10–15%) und „Real Characters“ als mittleres Segment in Grün (ca. 25–30%) beschriftet. Der äußere Ring unterteilt den blauen Bereich in fünf hellblaue Segmente „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“ und „Game Characters“ (wobei „Comic Characters“ und „Game Characters“ visuell zu den größeren hellblauen Anteilen zählen), den grünen Bereich in sieben hellgrüne Segmente „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ und „Influencers“ (mit „Musicians“ als größtem hellgrünen Segment), und der rosa Bereich bleibt ohne Unterkategorien. Es gibt keine separate Legende und keine Prozentwerte innerhalb der Segmente; die Kategorien sind direkt am jeweiligen Ring platziert, und die Segmente sind durch feine Trennlinien voneinander abgegrenzt.
